meta.name: CCNL per i lavoratori addetti all'industria delle calzature

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: conglobated (minimi retributivi include paga base, contingenza, and EDR). Modeled as base_salary with fixed_allowances: [] for all levels, level 8 included (the IND_FUN of the quadri is not modelled). Confirmed by stable coefficient ratios across all tranche dates (review of 2026-10-30).

LEVEL 1 SPECIAL TRANCHE: separate wage correction from 1 January 2025 (EUR 1,502.46, up from EUR 1,315.70 at Aug 2024), independent of standard tranche dates Aug 2024/Aug 2025/Aug 2026. Confirmed by fiscoetasse.com (rinnovo 2024) and web search: Jan 2025=1502.46, Aug 2025=1530.00, Aug 2026=1557.00. Modeled as a four-period series for level 1 only.
SENIORITY (Art. 46, p. 97 of the text of 17 July 2024): five increments, 'i primi quattro con cadenza biennale ed il quinto dopo un quadriennio', of 6.89 (1st) to 12.24 (8th) EUR a month.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: cadence and amounts read in art. 46 of the 2024 text on 2026-11-06.

notes.text: Workers covered: approximately 75,000 (Assocalzaturifici member companies). Agreement signed 2024-07-17; valid 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
INPS rates from 2026-industria.json (same sector as metalmeccanico). IRPEF 2026 brackets applied (L. 199/2025).

APPRENTICESHIP (professionalizzante): 80/90/100% in three periods. Total duration 36 months per Art. apprendistato. Period splits by level group: L6-L8=10/10/16m, L3-L5=11/11/14m, L2-L2S=12/12/12m. L1 not eligible as destination. Source: CCNL 2024-07-17 Assocalzaturifici (D121), circolare apprendistato; businessonline.it article 2024; kitech.it scheda D121.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Art. 23 Apprendistato, p. 52 of the CCNL industria delle calzature 17 July 2024, https://www.falc.biz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/CCNL-contratto-collettivo-nazionale-di-lavoro-calzaturiero-2024.pdf, sha256 fd48de9dd4aa81fd5ca97c3dd94099d085ac61666831e6da37fe2fbab19558cf): 'L’anzianità durante il rapporto di apprendistato è utile per la maturazione e per la corresponsione degli aumenti periodici di anzianità. Gli aumenti saranno commisurati alle stesse percentuali del minimo contrattuale': the level increments, reduced by the apprenticeship percentage (seniority_increments.apprentice_level_amount and apprentice_pct_scaled).

APPRENTICESHIP PERCENTAGE (art. 23, p. 52 of the text of 17 July 2024): '80% [90%, 100%] del minimo contrattuale del livello assegnato', the increments 'commisurati alle stesse percentuali del minimo contrattuale': the percentage reduces the minimo only, so the quadri function allowance is not reduced (apprenticeship_pct_relevant false).

OBJECTIVE 1 AREAS (art. 23, p. 52): 'Nelle aree di cui all'obiettivo 1 del regolamento 93/2081/CEE ... la retribuzione degli apprendisti è stabilita nelle seguenti misure: 70% ... 80% ... 90% del minimo contrattuale del livello assegnato'; the Protocollo sul Mezzogiorno names Basilicata, Calabria, Campania, Puglia, Sardegna and Sicilia. The request has no workplace region, so every apprentice takes 80/90/100%.

limitation.remediation: State whether the workplace is in an Objective 1 region and pay the apprentice 70/80/90% there.

notes.text: COMPORTO OF SEVERAL ILLNESSES (Art. 58 B - Malattia, conservazione del posto e chiarimento a verbale, PDF p. 16, https://az-apim-cne-sa-0002-lgc-we.azure-api.net/ricerca-api/ricerca/pubblica/accordi/scarica/accordi/194333, sha256 b9fd63ceec2324fdcf4b96702f89ab5ce1b31df489027e81b81caca4c4132866): 'L'obbligo di conservazione del posto per l'azienda cesserà comunque ove nell'arco di 30 mesi si raggiungano i limiti predetti anche con più malattie con esclusione, per entrambi i limiti, dei periodi di ricovero ospedaliero. [...] il periodo di conservazione del posto si considera nell'ambito di un periodo mobile da determinare con riferimento ai 909 giorni di calendario immediatamente precedenti. Il periodo di conservazione del posto di 13 mesi è pari a 394 giorni di calendario' Modelled as sickness_rules.comporto_windows: 394 days within 909 days before the day, hospital stays left out. The pay bands of the operai count by day of each illness; those of the impiegati and quadri (6 months in full, then half to the end of the comporto) say nothing on several episodes and are counted per illness.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

reviews.scope: CCNL Calzaturiero, text of 17 July 2024: art. 46 seniority (p. 97).
findings: Four biennial increments and a fifth after four years, not five triennial; the amounts per level match.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 32 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 0 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Art. 23 apprenticeship pay of the text of 17 July 2024 (p. 52).
findings: The percentage applies to the minimo contrattuale only: the quadri function allowance is not reduced.
The lower rates of the Objective 1 areas were not recorded: now a limitation.

reviews.scope: Comporto of several illnesses, against the research of a separate model session; quote checked on the source.
findings: Added the comporto window of the CCNL; the pay bands across episodes stay under the engine limitation sickness_cumulation_window.
